items.title: They’re bringing sexy back – but this time it’s classy | Jess Cartner-Morley
items.summary:
From a V-neck sweater worn back-to-front to a perfectly framed collarbone – here’s the secret to low-stakes sex appeal

I’m not sure when it started being not chic to want to look sexy, but it’s definitely a thing and it bothers me as it doesn’t feel truthful to the human experience, if that’s not a lot for the first sentence of a fashion column. Our wardrobes have become shrines to good taste. Well-cut coats and quality knitwear, elegant flat shoes and crisp white shirts. These clothes are excellent at communicating that you have read the briefing notes for the meeting and have some Booker prize chat. They are less good at suggesting you might be up for dancing on a table later.

Why do we have to choose? Clothes have always been partly about how they make us feel physically. We accept that an outfit can make you feel powerful, cool, smart. Why shouldn’t it also make you feel hot and fun?

items.t: They’re bringing sexy back – but this time it’s classy | Jess Cartner-Morley

items.title: LISA Gives The Nike Zoom Streak 3 "Black/Red" an Early Debut at the F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix
items.summary:
Summary 

LISA wore an unreleased pair of Nike Zoom Streak 3 sneakers in Black/Red to the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix drivers paradeFirst introduced in 2009, the racing flat pairs a one-piece mesh upper with a Cushlon midsole and a Zoom Air heelThe sighting is one of the first public moments since Nike and Formula 1 announced their long-term global partnership

The Nike Zoom Streak 3 got an early public outing in Las Vegas when global musician and Nike ambassador LISA wore an unreleased Black/Red pair to the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix drivers parade. Appearing alongside drivers Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc, she gave the public its first look at a colorway from the Zoom Streak 3 collection due in Spring 2027.

The Zoom Streak 3 was built for racing, and its construction reflects that. A one-piece mesh upper keeps weight to a minimum and cuts down on overlays, while a Cushlon midsole provides responsive, low-profile cushioning. A Zoom Air unit in the heel adds impact protection without making the shoe heavier, a balance of lightness and performance that made the model a favorite among Nike athletes after its 2009 debut.

The shoe's racing record backs up that reputation. Between 2009 and 2013, no earlier Nike racing shoe had been worn across more finish lines than the Zoom Streak 3, which made it one of the brand's most successful racing flats. Now Nike is pulling it from the archive and repositioning the low-slung silhouette as an everyday sneaker, and the Black/Red colorway gives it a sharp, high-contrast look.

The setting for the reveal was deliberate. LISA…
items.t: LISA Gives The Nike Zoom Streak 3 "Black/Red" an Early Debut at the F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix

Cactus Plant Flea Market and Nike have revealed the official images of the Flea 1 "Cave Purple," listed as Cave Purple/Dark Raisin-Purple Dynasty. The colorway covers the silhouette in tonal purple from top to bottom and adds a heavily textured sole that gives the pair a rugged, almost unfinished look.

Suede makes up most of the upper, wrapping the shoe in a soft purple finish across a series of geometric panels. The paneling is where the Flea 1's roots show, with clear nods to the Dunk and the Air Force 1 , though CPFM pulls the overall shape well away from either one. A heavily padded collar and an oversized tongue add bulk around the ankle and give the shoe its chunky, cushioned profile.

The sole is the most unusual part of the build. Rather than a clean, smooth cupsole, the dark purple unit has a rough, uneven surface that looks like dried mud, so the pair appears worn in straight out of the box. It's also a shade darker than the upper, which keeps the tonal look from feeling flat.

Contrast is saved for the back of the shoe. A black-and-white yin-yang logo sits on the heel, the only real break from the purple, and CPFM branding appears across the rest of the design. "Cave Purple" is one of two Flea 1 colorways the pair has lined up for the holidays, alongside a "Barley" version , and LeBron James was recently spotted wearing the purple pair ahead of the official reveal.

Fred again.. is suiting up for his India tour with a limited-edition cricket shirt made with Monkey Shoulder Lifestyle, Merch & Music Collective and Nike . The base of the shirt comes straight from cricket history. Gaur takes the geometric graphics of India's 2011 kit and lays them over the bright blue of the 2007 kit, so two separate eras of the team's identity appear together on one jersey. Those years carry real weight for fans, as India won the ICC World Twenty20 in 2007 and the ICC Cricket World Cup on home soil in 2011, which makes the shirt a tribute to two trophy runs.

The finishing details make it Fred's own. His distinct visual language is worked into the design alongside the Monkey Shoulder Lifestyle, Merch & Music Collective logo, and the partnership marks the first time the William Grant & Sons India lifestyle brand has named a Creative Partner. The result looks like matchday gear and works as tour merch at the same time.

Prime Video officially brought a familiar face to its highly anticipated God of War TV series. Deborah Ann Woll joined the live-action adaptation of the blockbuster Santa Monica Studio video game franchise as Faye. The television show follows the Greek god of war, Kratos, as he travels with his son Atreus to scatter the ashes of his late wife Faye from the highest peak in the Nine Realms.

Producers kept Woll’s involvement strictly under wraps due to a behind-the-scenes production pivot. Amazon picked up the God of War series for two seasons, which crews are filming back-to-back. Four of the first season's ten episodes were filmed in spring 2026 before production stopped when original Kratos actor Ryan Hurst injured his shoulder on set. items.title: Blancpain Unveils New Watch Featuring the World's First 30-Degree Inclined One-Minute Flying Carrousel
items.summary:
Blancpain, the world's oldest watch brand founded in Villeret, Switzerland in 1735, has announced a new watch, the Tourbillon Carrousel Inclined. Completed after four years of development, this model features what the brand claims to be the world's first one-minute flying carrousel inclined at 30 degrees.

The carrousel is a mechanism designed to minimize the rate variations caused by the orientation of the watch. By housing the balance wheel and escapement—which regulate the timekeeping—in a rotating cage, it averages out the effects of gravity. In 2008, Blancpain introduced a wristwatch equipped with a flying carrousel whose cage makes one full rotation per minute. For this new release, tilting the rotation axis of that cage by 30 degrees ensures that the orientation of the balance wheel continues to change relative to gravity even when the watch is laid flat with the dial facing up.

During development, multiple inclination angles from 0 to 35 degrees were tested, measuring amplitude and rate across six different positions. As a result, 30 degrees was adopted as the angle that best balances precision performance, movement thinness, and design. The newly developed manual-winding Calibre 222ISQ secures a 100-hour power reserve via two series-connected barrels. Furthermore, every piece comes with an individual chronometry certificate showing an average daily rate tolerance between 0 and +2 seconds.

The exterior also boasts a major distinguishing feature. It adopts Blancpain's first-ever full sapphire case, with sapphire also used for the dial. The movement's action can be…
items.t: Blancpain Unveils New Watch Featuring the World's First 30-Degree Inclined One-Minute Flying Carrousel

Starbucks Japan launched its unconventional winter offering, the Potato Soupaccino, on November 13. The menu item is a half-soup, half-cappuccino hybrid beverage that blurs the line between a traditional hot drink and a savory comfort meal. By launching this savory option, the brand continues a regional trend of offering exclusive winter coffee alternatives that bypass Western menus.

For this winter season, Starbucks added a potato flavor to the lineup to create a profile rooted in culinary comfort. The Potato Soupaccino features a pillowy texture reminiscent of freshly baked potatoes. To build the flavor profile, the recipe combines an earthy potato base with caramelized onions and subtle notes of sweet vegetables.

The preparation process embraces a traditional coffeehouse aesthetic. Starbucks baristas finish the drink by adding a frothy layer of cappuccino foam on top of the savory base. Customers can choose their preferred milk variety for the foam layer to customize the beverage.

The fabric is the main change. Each bag uses the same 100% plant-derived nylon found across the TANKER family , a material that is credited as the first of its kind to reach mass production. Changing what the bags are made of while keeping the TANKER identity means the renewal is about substance more than appearance, and the shell keeps the distinctive surface texture the line is recognized for.

Construction is where PORTER's craftsmanship shows. The bags are put together with very precise sewing and carefully engineered components, and the coloring has been refined to match. Two new colorways join the series, and the straps can now be adjusted in length, so each piece can be fitted to the body whether it's worn as a tote, carried as a daypack or strapped across the waist as a hip bag.

items.title: ‘GTA VI’ Stays Off Limits, But Hollywood Can Reportedly Have ‘Red Dead Redemption’ for $100 Million USD
items.summary:
Summary 

Rockstar Games is reportedly more open to bringing 'Red Dead Redemption' to film or television, even as it continues to turn down Hollywood interest in 'Grand Theft Auto'An unnamed agent claims the studio at one point floated a licensing price of more than $100 million USDNo studio, producer or talent has been tied to the project, and Rockstar has not commented

Rockstar Games may finally be willing to let Hollywood into its catalog, with Red Dead Redemption reportedly emerging as the franchise the studio is most open to adapting for film or TV. According to an exclusive report from Lesley Goldberg at The Ankler , multiple sources say Rockstar has become more receptive to a screen version of its Western series, while Grand Theft Auto is still firmly off the table despite years of interest from entertainment companies.

The reported figure is what makes this story stand out. An unnamed agent who works with writers in the video game space told The Ankler that Rockstar had, at one point, floated a minimum of more than $100 million USD for the licensing rights alone. For a sense of scale, the report sets that number beside the roughly $250 million USD Amazon reportedly paid in 2017 for the global TV rights to The Lord of the Rings . The wording suggests the figure came up in past discussions rather than as a current, finalized offer.

Beyond that price tag, almost nothing about a potential deal has been made public. The report doesn't say whether Rockstar would prefer a film or a series, and it names no bidders, studios, producers or talent attached to a Red Dead…
items.t: ‘GTA VI’ Stays Off Limits, But Hollywood Can Reportedly Have ‘Red Dead Redemption’ for $100 Million USD

UNDERCOVER and fragment design have unveiled the second chapter of their "Undercover meets Fragment" capsule, a mohair knit cardigan taken from the FW26 men's collection and reissued in a limited run of new colors. Jun Takahashi and Hiroshi Fujiwara offer the piece in two cuts, crew neck and V-neck, so this round is all about one garment rather than a full lineup.

Instead of spreading Drop 2 across several categories, the duo commits entirely to a single knit and changes only the neckline. The crew-neck version keeps the front closed and simple, while the V-neck opens up the chest and frames whatever is layered underneath. Both are cut from the same mohair knit, so choosing between them comes down to how you plan to wear it, not what it's made of.

Color is the other variable, and the two designers keep it disciplined. Each neckline is available in Ivory Base and Black Base, giving the cardigan a light, clean option and a darker one that sits easily inside an all-black wardrobe. Because the colors are produced in limited numbers, this version stands apart from the cardigan's original appearance in the seasonal collection.

The narrow format matches the idea behind the whole capsule. The project grew from a philosophy Takahashi and Fujiwara share: make the clothes they…

items.title: Y-3 and Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team Celebrate Constructors' Title with Jeff Hamilton

Debuted by drivers Kimi Antonelli and George Russell as they arrived at the Las Vegas Grand Prix, the Constructors’ Championship jacket translates the team’s achievement into a commemorative piece. Bringing Y-3’s distinctive design perspective together with Hamilton’s signature approach to championship apparel, the jacket arrives alongside a matching commemorative cap. Limited to 999 units each, the jacket is priced at €900 EUR (approx. $984 USD), and the cap is priced at €150 EUR (approx. $164 USD).

The Y-3 x Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team x Jeff Hamilton capsule collection opens for pre-order and sign-up on November 23 via adidas.com in North America and Europe, as well as via Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS Formula One Team Official Online Shop . Both pieces will see a broader release in early December 2026 through the same channels, as well as select physical locations across the world.

items.title: Yvng Patra Releases New Album 'Regalia' Featuring Kohjiya, Vingo, and More

Production is handled by Oddy lozy , TAXON , and VetteBoy , among others. Pxrge Trxxxper joins the high-energy party anthem "We Gon' Rock the Party," while close allies 042ghxst and Gam Ball guest on "Siren" and "Money Talks," respectively. Additionally, D.O provides spoken-word narration on "9 Tips," with S TILL I DIE adding a verse.

"Beyond," originally released in August 2026, is included as a remix featuring 27AM. "Night wida AMG" featuring Kohjiya boasts a West Coast-inspired sound, while the uptempo "One Time" features Vingo. Conversely, "Where is the Real Love" featuring DADA expresses serious emotions over a slow track. The album boasts a variety of moods, ranging from heavy-hitting bangers to more introspective cuts.

The album title, Regalia , refers to the emblems and ornaments symbolizing royalty and majesty. The project features lyrics that assert his position and presence within the scene, making it a work that showcases exactly where Yvng Patra stands today.

He has also announced a solo live show, "Yvng Patra One Man Live," to be held at Toyosu PIT in Tokyo on Saturday, March 20, 2027. Following his sold-out show at Zepp Shinjuku earlier this year, he is taking on a new stage at the largest venue of his career to date. The presale has ended, and general ticket sales are scheduled…

items.title: Original HAFERL x nonnative Collaborate on New Richard Cow Leather Shoes
items.summary:
A new collaboration shoe, the RICHARD COW LEATHER, is launching from Original HAFERL , a historic footwear manufacturer from the Allgäu region in Bavaria, southern Germany, and nonnative.

The base model, the RICHARD, is a mid-cut silhouette that carries on the legacy of the Haferlschuhe, a traditional shoe from the Allgäu region of southern Germany. Unlike the offset lacing typical of standard Haferl shoes, it features a distinctive center-laced design.

It uses the traditional Zwiegenäht (double stitch) construction, resulting in a durable and water-resistant finish. The upper materials are tailored to each colorway: the BLACK version is uniform in smooth leather, right down to the collar and lining. Meanwhile, the LT. BROWN utilizes suede leather, creating a striking contrast with the tan leather lining.

Furthermore, the meticulous attention to detail from both brands is evident in features like the lug-patterned Vibram® outsoles matched to the upper's tone, and the matte silver metal hooks at the collar. This pair seamlessly blends traditional European shoemaking with the nonnative philosophy.

The Original HAFERL x nonnative RICHARD COW LEATHER will be released on Saturday, November 28th at 11:00 AM at the nonnative shop, the nonnative shop Osaka, COVERCHORD Fukuoka, the COVERCHORD official online store , and select nonnative retailers. It will be available in two colors: LT. BROWN and BLACK. Priced at ¥86,900 (tax included), sizes range from 25 to 28.5 cm.

Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast
items.t: Original HAFERL x nonnative Collaborate on New Richard Cow Leather Shoes

items.title: CASETiFY Unveils a Pokémon Tech Accessory Collection Rendered in Pixel Art

CASETiFY has announced a tech accessory collection that expresses the world of Pokémon through pixel art. Celebrating Pokémon's 30-year journey, the collection fuses designs inspired by gaming culture with the brand's signature customizability and protective performance. items.title: BIRKENSTOCK Celebrates the 40th Anniversary of Its Iconic London Style with the "Camden's Clubs" Collection
items.summary:
German footwear brand BIRKENSTOCK has unveiled "1774 Camden's Clubs," a new collection inspired by London's music, fashion, and subcultures. Building on four of the brand's signature models—the Arizona, London, Boston, and Maria—the collection features silver cone studs and glossy brushed leather. It adds a rebellious edge evocative of punk and grunge to classic silhouettes.

The collection takes its name from the legendary music clubs scattered throughout London's Camden neighborhood. It focuses on the city's creative soil, where music, fashion, and various subcultures have intersected from King's Road to Camden.

This is rooted in the London youth culture of the early 1990s. Around Camden Lock at the time, grunge, hippie, and romantic styles mixed. It was common to see outfits layering delicate materials like lace and chiffon paired with rugged boots or BIRKENSTOCK clogs. The unique contrast created by boldly combining different tastes was a signature style of London in that era.

In a 1993 article for *The New York Times*, fashion journalist Suzy Menkes also highlighted the hippie style revival at Camden Lock. She described outfits that paired lightweight fabrics like lace skirts and chiffon blouses with heavy stockings, Dr. Martens boots, and BIRKENSTOCK clogs. This collection can be seen as a modern reinterpretation of the fashion scene of that time, where these contrasting elements coexisted.

A standout in the collection is the London, which celebrates its 40th anniversary this year. Introduced in 1986 by Karl Birkenstock, it was the brand's first shoe to cover both…

items.title: Ki One Becomes the First Korean Distillery to Win IWSC's Worldwide Whiskey Producer Trophy
items.summary:
Summary 

Ki One Whisky Distillery won the IWSC 2026 Worldwide Whiskey Producer Trophy, an award given to a distillery's whole range rather than a single bottleTo make the shortlist, a producer has to enter at least three products, medal with every one and take at least two GoldsKi One went eight for eight on medals, with Ki One Eagle and Ki One Moon both winning Gold

Ki One Whisky Distillery has won the Worldwide Whiskey Producer Trophy at the IWSC 2026 Awards Ceremony, held November 24 at Outernet Live in London. The Namyangju-based distillery is the first from Korea to be shortlisted for the trophy and the first to win it. The award comes a year after Ki One Unicorn took the competition's top single-bottle honor, the Worldwide Whiskey Trophy.

The format of the Producer Trophy is what makes the win significant, because it judges a distillery's whole output rather than its single best bottle. Producers only reach the shortlist if they enter three or more products in the category, every one of those entries wins a medal, and at least two of the medals are Gold. The IWSC judging committee then reviews the finalists and picks a winner based on overall medal performance and the results of Trophy Judging.

Ki One cleared that bar comfortably this year. It entered eight whiskies and every one came away with a medal, including Golds for Ki One Eagle and Ki One Moon. The entries were judged double-blind by a panel drawn from more than 30 countries, as part of a competition that takes in around 5,000 wine and spirits entries from roughly 90 countries each year.

items.title: Children of the revolution: how the north of England is defining modern men’s fashion
items.summary:
Once the historic centre of the textile industry, the north is now home to a host of a provenance-driven labels. But is there a specific northern menswear look? And what does it all mean for the mad-fer-it stereotypes?

In 2026, clothing has proved more important to Andy Burnham’s political identity than that of any British prime minister since Margaret Thatcher. He is a loyal Clarks and Adidas wearer, whose Howick worker’s jacket hangs in Manchester’s People’s History Museum. His ousting of Keir Starmer – launched shortly before being photographed jogging in a replica Everton shirt – has been memorialised as the “casual coup”. In one telling, the reason for this is simple: he’s a man from the north.

That Burnham is the first born-and-bred northern male PM since Harold Wilson last swished his Gannex raincoat out of Downing Street goes some way to explaining his higher interest in clothing. It’s not necessarily that all men in the south care less about clothing, or that all men in the north do – but that many men from the north express it in such a distinctive, even unified, way.

items.title: Brioche armchairs, butter sculptures and edible chandeliers: meet the new food artists
items.summary:
Culinary artists are turning fashion shows and design fairs into a feast for the eyes

A pretty Venetian chandelier featuring delicate pink flowers and cascading blue leaves hangs from a ceiling. A hazy, warm light radiates from its tulip bulbs. Suddenly, a woman reaches up and snaps off one of the flower stems, giggling as she begins to nibble it. Welcome to the weird and wonderful world of Laila Gohar. The Egyptian-born, New York-based artist is part of a new wave of culinary artists blurring the lines between sustenance and spectacle, and this troupe have quickly become a firm fixture at fashion parties and design fairs, turning dining into a phenomenon and delight.

Gohar describes the chandelier, made entirely from hand-spun sugar (including the silver chain that suspended it) as her “favourite thing she has done in recent history”. It joins a long list of extravagant yet still edible installations she has created, including lifesize armchairs made of brioche, an entire room constructed with Belgian chocolate and a four-metre-long mortadella that had to be lifted into the party’s venue using a crane.
